plugin.name: StepUpOnto SKSE patch (only if you use StepUpOnto SKSE)
plugin.description:
NPC Pathing NG is fully installed without this. Just press Install.
Tick this ONLY if you use "StepUpOnto SKSE" together with SkyParkour. It adds a SkyParkour-aware build of StepUpOntoSKSE.dll (same settings, same INI) that stays hands-off while a SkyParkour move is running. It replaces StepUpOnto's own DLL, so leave it unticked if you do not have StepUpOnto: it would otherwise add StepUpOnto's step-up behaviour to your game.
Changed your mind later? Reinstall without it, or just delete the patched StepUpOntoSKSE.dll from this mod.
